steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get out of the way!! Hella is going into smash mode!!
She swings with her pipe and actually opens up a path for you.
You reach the bottom of the staircase, and through the strewn plaster pieces, you can already see Sosia's back. The shackles are also reacting, which means Enfer is there!
The statue turns slightly sideways, and just when you think she's going to look up. A sudden bright light briefly deprives you of all senses...
Your senses return. The chaos is gone, and so are the Sinners. You're in an empty room with pure white walls. It's so quiet you can only hear your own breathing.

There are paintings of various sizes hanging on the wall. In front of the largest portrait in the center stands a woman wearing white. She has two hands clasped behind her back and two in front of her, and her seemingly soft hair is completely still.
The woman has her back to you and is quietly admiring the painting.
She doesn't turn around or answer, but you know she invited you here.
